independent_field_evidence.claim: 139th Canton Fair drew 314,000+ overseas buyers from 220 countries/regions, US$25.7B on-site intended orders, and many buyers scheduled follow-up factory visits.
140th Canton Fair opens 2026-10-15, providing a recurring global-buyer event source rather than a single gig.
QIMA Q2 data reports China inspection demand +18% YoY from emerging-market clients outside Asia; China is 78% of their inspection/audit demand and 81% for South/Latin America.
China local field-execution network reports 1,000+ enterprise customers, 2M+ site checks, task decomposition by address/evidence/acceptance, local-person matching and QA.

downstream_flow_evidence.claim: Recurring business-information client posts a standardized Suzhou site-verification task at US$20-45 with address, operating hours, photo/video/observation SOP and one-city/one-freelancer allocation.
The same site-verification pattern appears in Shanghai at US$20-35, supporting repeated city-by-city recruitment rather than one isolated buyer.
The same pattern appears in Wenzhou at US$20-40 with milestone release after the visit.
Current open Guangzhou factory-verification task budgets CAD30-250; deliverables are existence/contact confirmation, permitted photos/video, documents and a short English report.
Current incumbent offers defined China factory/site visits with checklist, permitted evidence and reporting, but explicitly excludes covert investigation and specialist certification.
Professional incumbent publicly prices QC at US$248/man-day and factory audit at US$268/man-day and requires full payment at least three days before inspection.

platform_execution_constraints.claim: Freelancer Corporate Teams supports team bidding, team management and shared billing; any routed execution must be transparent and platform-compliant.
Freelancer recommends funded Milestone Payments before work begins; funds are held until release.
Fixed-price freelancer fee is 10% of project value or US$5 minimum, so normalized margin must include platform fees.

first_bootstrap_queue.title: Guangzhou bounded factory-existence and visible-evidence visit
first_bootstrap_queue.why_first: Current, bounded, decision-linked, mostly observable evidence rather than technical certification; budget is materially above the Confirmis micro-task tier.
hard_unknowns: No platform-funded milestone has been observed for our participation.
No compliant team/agency configuration has been established for this account.
No Guangzhou executor is OPTIONED and no same-scope market cost is bound.
Site access/filming permission must be confirmed by the buyer/supplier.
first_bootstrap_queue.next_safe_action: Bind a real Guangzhou executor quote and platform/team eligibility; do not bid or incur cost until the user authorizes the account action and funded milestone is visible.

first_bootstrap_queue.title: Suzhou standardized site-verification micro-task
first_bootstrap_queue.why_not_first: Excellent repeatability evidence, but US$20-45 leaves little room for orchestration unless execution is truly hyperlocal and aggregated; use to learn task protocol and demand-pump behavior, not to manufacture margin.

first_bootstrap_queue.title: Multi-supplier technical factory inspection across China
first_bootstrap_queue.why_rejected: Requires quality/process judgment across electronics/textiles and recommendations; advertised US$2-8/hour is weak for a routed multi-party model and drifts into expert inspection.

decisive_unknown: Will a recurring overseas verification/business-information demand pump buy China-wide standardized field-evidence capacity from one orchestrated coverage layer instead of repeatedly recruiting one city-level freelancer at a time?
